lines: Shake off the bond-roads, drink deep of things — burnt clean in praise-fire;
mad-drunk on glory's rush, O giver — bliss is mine.

verses.craft: Shake-drink-burnt triad; mad-drunk bliss-mine close; bond-roads kept.
